name: v0.3.89 — Chat safety + one-tap data deletion
releaseNotes:
• Chat: you can now Block and Report anyone from a conversation's ⋮ menu — blocked people can't message you.
• Privacy: a Delete-my-data button now sits in the top-right of every screen — one tap (and a confirm) permanently erases your account and all data.
• Reliability tweaks.
